payload.description: Found 2026-10-22 by lane MAIL: geteuid and/or unlinkat are called through their own unsafe libc blocks in run-supervisor (gate/unix.rs), secrets (file_source.rs), holder-lock (route.rs), git (wal.rs, worktree.rs, node-addon single_load.rs) and now mailbox store (record/sys.rs). Design principle 2: shared primitives live in the lowest layer that needs them. Candidate owner: HARDEN (low-layer API consolidation) or the process/durable-file leaf. Mailbox will move to the shared leaf when it exists.
payload.title: One shared leaf for euid and dirfd syscalls (geteuid, unlinkat) instead of per-crate unsafe copies
payload.verify: rg geteuid|unlinkat in non-test src finds calls only through one shared module

payload.description: Found 2026-10-23 by lane MAIL V5 phase 2 (report plans/reports/research-261023-0148-mailbox-v5-measurements.md on branch mailbox/v1-v3): the Git floor probe / state-root resolution falls back to a relative .local/state/fgos when both HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME are unset, so state is written under whatever cwd the caller has (a repo, a hook cwd, a sandbox). payload.description: Found 2026-10-23 by the MAIL V5 review (L6a, plans/261023-0013-mailbox-v5-native-hook-door/reports/code-review-v5.md): the host's per-route flag projection lists positional parameters (e.g. mailbox send's body) as accepted --flags, so --body passes the host flag check and is refused only later by the verb (exit 4). payload.description: Seen 2026-10-23 by lane MAIL on every branch and clean-main npm test run on fg-server: 18 failures in test/rust-host/fgctl-upgrade.test.mjs (15), fgctl-init-download-sources (2) and one dispatch test (codex cli-bypass model placeholder). Cause measured by the MAIL V7c lead: the Git driver refuses fresh test state directories created mode 0775 under this machine's umask 002 (and under umask 022 'git-empty-hooks must have mode 0500'). Tests should create their state dirs with explicit modes, or the driver check should be satisfied by the fixture. Owner lane: GIT.
payload.title: Git driver refuses test state dirs created under umask 002, failing 18 npm tests on fg-server
payload.verify: npm test on fg-server (umask 002) shows no fgctl-upgrade / fgctl-init-download-sources / dispatch codex-placeholder failures

payload.description: Measured 2026-10-24 by lane MAIL V7f probe W7 (Claude Code 2.1.309): a raw same-user write to a session's socket at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cc-socks/<pid>.sock, with no from_mode, into a prompting-mode session with no crossSessionInbound setting, is accepted with no dialog and starts a turn in ~1.25 s, delivered as a user-role message inside Claude's 'treat it as a teammate's request' frame. Bypass-mode sessions hold it (W2, W2b). BLIND_HIDDEN_ROOTS in src/runner/dispatch/confinement/resources.mjs on main does not list cc-socks or /run/user; whether bwrap launches expose it is unverified. If exposed, any confined runner worker could steer the owner's open Claude sessions. Needs: verify exposure with a real-bwrap test, then mask the Claude socket dir (or all of /run/user as MAIL's V7 harness does). Owner lane: runner confinement. Also relevant to the K1 rule in docs/platform/agent-mailbox/spec.md §7.2.
payload.title: Confined workers may reach Claude Code session sockets (/run/user/<uid>/cc-socks) and inject into…
payload.verify: a hostRead:blind confined worker cannot stat or connect to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/cc-socks/*.sock (real-bwrap test with falsifier)

payload.description: Found 2026-10-24 by the confinement fix for tsk-2gsbfe4lqh (branch confinement/hide-claude-sockets): herdr's socket ~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock is hidden only for hostRead:blind dispatches. herdr can type into panes, so a non-blind confined worker reaching it could drive the owner's terminal sessions, comparable to the Claude cc-socks exposure. Needs: confirm whether non-blind workers legitimately need herdr; if not, add it to the machine-private hidden roots with a probe and falsifier. Also review other user-runtime sockets reachable by workers (ssh-agent, gpg-agent, dbus, systemd).
payload.title: Non-blind confined workers can reach herdr's control socket (~/.config/herdr/herdr.sock)
payload.verify: a non-blind confined worker cannot stat or connect to herdr.sock (real-bwrap probe with falsifier), or a recorded decision explains why non-blind workers need it

payload.description: Found 2026-10-24 by the independent review of the cc-socks confinement fix (report: ~/projects/forgent-worktrees/mailbox-evidence/code-review-confinement-cc-socks.md). Non-blind confined workers see the user runtime dir; systemd-run --user via the user manager would run commands unconfined, and the session bus carries the secret service (live on fg-server). Plausible, not exercised against the live sockets. Candidate fix: hide all of {runtimeDir} for confined workers and bind back only each worker's own attempt socket under {runtimeDir}/fgos; needs an owner decision. Lane: runner confinement.
payload.title: Confined non-blind workers can reach the systemd user manager and session D-Bus (systemd-run…
payload.verify: a confined worker of every policy cannot reach $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/systemd/private, the user bus socket, or org.freedesktop.secrets (real-bwrap probe with falsifier)

payload.description: Found 2026-10-24 by the same review: credential-agent sockets in the user runtime dir are reachable by non-blind confined workers, so a worker could sign with the owner's keys. Plausible, not exercised. Same candidate fix as the systemd/bus item (hide {runtimeDir}, bind back own attempt socket). Also: {runtimeDir}/fgos is bound writable into every terminal launch, so a worker reaches every attempt's control socket, not only its own; and pipewire/pulse/X11 sockets are reachable. Lane: runner confinement.
payload.title: Confined non-blind workers can reach ssh-agent, gpg-agent and gnome-keyring control sockets
payload.verify: a confined worker cannot use SSH_AUTH_SOCK / gpg-agent / keyring sockets (real-bwrap probe with falsifier)
